foundry_calls.text: Every pull on the rope tears at your wounded side; halfway up, the bandage is wet through and your arms are shaking. You make the lip of the pit gasping, one hand pressed hard against the wound.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: That climb was brutal on your injured side — roll a Constitution check to avoid reopening the wound.
foundry_calls.speaker: Aria

llm_calls: [Aria]: I climb the rope out of the pit.
